entity.name: DataSpoof Edtech Private Limited
entity.description: DataSpoof Edtech Private Limited is an India-based technology company building software and open-source tools for data science, machine learning and artificial intelligence. DataSpoof develops MLPilot, an open-source machine-learning engineering framework designed to help developers move from raw data to monitored production models through automation, explainability and auditable workflows.

projects.name: DataSpoof MLPilot
projects.description:
MLPilot is an open-source machine-learning engineering framework that helps developers take machine-learning projects from raw data to monitored production models. It brings key stages of the ML lifecycle into one workflow, including data ingestion and preparation, data quality checks, feature engineering, model training and evaluation, explainability, experiment management, deployment and model monitoring. Its Python-first interface and Rust-powered components aim to make machine-learning workflows efficient, reproducible and easier to maintain.

MLPilot is built for data scientists, ML engineers, researchers and teams that want a more integrated path from experimentation to production. The project aims to reduce fragmented tooling and make production-oriented machine learning more accessible through an open-source, auditable framework.

plans.name: MLPilot Core Development
plans.description: Annual funding request to support core development of the MLPilot open-source framework. Funding will contribute to engineering time for implementing and improving core capabilities, Python and Rust integration, performance and reliability, automated testing, code quality, developer documentation and production readiness. The goal is to make MLPilot more useful, dependable and sustainable for its open-source users and contributors.
